newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's CST issues $300 mln in securitized debt.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's CST issues $300 mln in securitized debt.

text.p: Brazilian steelmaker Companhia Siderurgica de Tubarao (CST) said it has closed a $300 million securitized debt deal backed by export receivables.
CST, the world's largest producer of steel plates, said in a statement that $120 million of the issue bears an 8.22 percent fixed interest rate due 2004.

Another $90 million of certificates was issued with a floating rate of 1.25 percent over LIBOR, expiring 2002. The third batch totalling another $90 million was absorbed in restructuring of past financing "on terms favorable to the company."
Proceeds from the securitization program are being used to finance CST's investments aimed at reducing costs and modernizing and boosting output capacity at the firm, based in Espirito Santo state.
The program began in 1993 with a disbursement of $370 million and a second phase, begun in 1996, foresees total disbursement of another $900 million.
